title: Granville_attempt2
summary: A collection of synthetic-data-generation scripts (NoGAN, DeepResampling, NoGAN_Hellinger) created for a generative-AI fellowship tied to Vincent Granville's book Synthetic Data and Generative AI. One script instantiates SDV's CopulaGAN synthesizer and demo datasets, and another builds an SDV SingleTableMetadata object to profile a CSV, using SDV as one of several tabular synthesis approaches explored.
